description: Erection of a rear extension to the warehouse
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: SK2/REVB/2018, 109/ExistingFP, 109/FPPREVA/2018, 1480/1A, 1480/1AB, 1480/3C, Location Plan, Cover Letter, Eco Shelter Range specification (Urban Shelters; product ref. USP/ES12/6HR), Sustainability Assessment (dated 12th October 2023), Transport Assessment (dated October 2023) Environmental Risk Assessment (dated 7th August 2012) and Ground Assessment (dated June 2002). Received 18th October 2023

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 4 - During the course of the development: 
a.	The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess any such additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues. These amendments shall demonstrate how the unsuspected contamination will be dealt with and set out appropriate remediation measures.
Before the development is first brought into use:
b.	The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clause a) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

Condition : 5 - Before the extension hereby permitted is brought into use the cycle parking facilities shown on the approved drawings 1480/1A and 1480/1AB and Eco Shelter Range specification (Urban Shelters; product ref. USP/ES12/6HR), received 18th October 2023, shall be provided and thereafter retained as such.

Condition : 6 - Prior to first occupation of the extension hereby permitted an evidence pack (including for example manufactures literature, post construction reports, photos and statements of compliance) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Sustainability Assessment (dated 12th October 2023).

Condition : 7 - The extension hereby approved shall be used for general industrial and/or storage and distribution purposes and shall remain ancillary to the use of the building to which it would be adjoined; it shall be used for no other purposes.

Condition : 8 - The existing vehicular crossover and entrance on the south-eastern elevation of the application site, adjacent to the development hereby permitted, shall be made good, and the kerb and verge/footway reinstated, at the expense of the applicant, prior to the first occupation of the hereby approved single storey rear extension
